nodes.name: 9am ET Mon-Fri
nodes.notes: Fires at 9am ET. Set n8n instance timezone to America/New_York. Workflow paused in dry-run mode.

nodes.name: Config
nodes.notes: daily_cap starts at 10. Set dry_run=false when domain is warm (~2026-04-30). Increase daily_cap by 10 each week.

nodes.name: Claude: Generate Email
nodes.notes: Using HTTP Request instead of LangChain node for more control over the payload.

nodes.name: Add Lead to Instantly
nodes.notes: REPLACE_WITH_CAMPAIGN_ID — create the campaign in Instantly first, then paste its ID here. Campaign template should use {{email_subject}} and {{email_body}} custom variables.

parameters.jsonBody:
={
  "prospect_id": {{ $json.prospect_id }},
  "type": "cold",
  "subject": {{ JSON.stringify($json.subject) }},
  "body": {{ JSON.stringify($json.body) }},
  "sent_by": {{ JSON.stringify($json.sent_by) }},
  "status": "sent",
  "sent_at": "{{ new Date().toISOString() }}",
  "batch_name": "lodge-auto-{{ new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0] }}"
}

nodes.name: Dry Run Log
nodes.notes: In dry-run mode: logs the generated email but does NOT send via Instantly or update CRM status. Review output to validate email quality before going live.
